name: C:\OVER\MIND
source:
Follow Alexander Blackwood as he explores the Godcomplex, a mental institution built after the end of the world, meant to alleviate the sufferings of the souls of now-deceased people.  Look for Doctor Jacob Stedman: he will be the one to rid this world of misery.

[From [url=https://sugarychamomile.itch.io/overmind]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随亚历山大·布莱克伍德 (Alexander Blackwood) 探索上帝综合体 (Godcomplex)，这是世界末日后建造的一座精神病院，旨在减轻已故之人灵魂的痛苦。寻找雅各布·斯特德曼医生：他将是那个让这个世界摆脱痛苦的人。

[来自[url=https://sugarychamomile.itch.io/overmind]Itch.io[/url]]
